# Lucide icon subset

BokOPDS adapts a small subset of Lucide's 24 by 24 SVG stroke geometry for
direct SDL rendering. The upstream reference is Lucide `0.577.0`, commit
`0ea8780434e2b4527dc860b18ff94883d080b59c`. The adapted icons remain
outline-only and use the same round-cap, round-join visual language. See
`LICENSE` in this directory.
